name: FrenchModelVariant789_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/image31368_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (three 128-point walks shared with the French MODEL52364 family, with launched wings and timed fades); for a non-negative request it selects the command row indexed by the request and packs the image records that follow the scale vector, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md, notes/overlays/french-model-image31368-entry.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US header-772/869 and Japanese images build the same source through model_variant/variant772_entry.c, which selects the 240-line height, at the same addresses. French header 789 is this raw image's header word, not the US header-789 source model_variant/variant789_entry.c. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
